Third-party code, copied unmodified. Nothing here is edited by hand.

GSAP 3.15.0 (gsap, ScrollTrigger, Flip)
  Source:  npm package "gsap" 3.15.0, files in dist/*.min.js
  Site:    https://gsap.com
  License: GSAP Standard "no charge" license, https://gsap.com/standard-license
           (free to use, including these plugins; not an MIT license)

They are classic scripts (UMD): they define window.gsap, window.ScrollTrigger
and window.Flip, so they load from file:// with no server.

  gsap.min.js           the engine (every page)
  ScrollTrigger.min.js  the pinned shelf, the reading-progress bar, figure reveals
  Flip.min.js           the archive's animated filtering (archive.html only)
